note: There's no Preservation-specific per-dungeon guide (the per-dungeon tips on Wowhead's M+ tips page are "coming soon"), so Preservation boss notes apply the general M+ principles from Wowhead's Preservation rotation guide (keep Reversion up after Temporal Anomaly, Dream Breath and Zephyr before big damage, Rewind right after) to each mechanic. Dispel types were checked against in-game tooltips.

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Pop Zephyr (2 min, 20% less AoE damage) for Ravenous Stomp's party damage, and put Reversion on anyone stunned by a falling stalactite

The Writhing Coil: [광역 피해] During the 35 sec Synchronized Venom DoT, keep Reversion on the whole party by repeating Temporal Anomaly followed by Reversion on cooldown
[광역 피해] Pop Zephyr before Death Rattle, and use Rewind right before the vines break when damage peaks

[제어] In the Uncoil phase, when the group gathers and stuns the Writhes, use Oppressing Roar (1 min 30 sec with Overawe) toward them just before so the stuns last 50% longer, and clear any Spiteful Venom poison that still stacks with Naturalize
Zul'jan: [광역 피해] Lay down Temporal Anomaly right before the 8 sec Ritual of the Fang channel. Spread beam soakers are not all reached by Zephyr (4 allies within 20 yd), so alternate Rewind, which reaches everyone within 40 yd, with Dream Breath and Emerald Blossom stored in Stasis for the channels
[참고] Put Reversion on players who cleared Ritual Venom with Boneslicer or a slowed Axegrinder axe so they can take the Physical damage
[위치] Use Hover to keep casting while you return to the same beam spot each Ritual

Lightblossom Trinity: [위치] Players standing in Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam take the pool's Nature damage (77586 every 1 sec) plus the beam's Holy damage (77586 every 2 sec). Do not Rescue them out before the beam ends; keep them up with Temporal Anomaly and Reversion, and only Rescue someone who cannot leave the 50% slow after the beam
[탱버] Bedrock Slam (484912 Physical + 193965 Nature, 3 sec cast) comes soon after the beam soak, so hold Time Dilation during the soak and put it on the tank as the cast starts
[광역 피해] Pop Zephyr and lay down Dream Breath before the 8 sec Lightbloom Overgrowth AoE
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Bloodthorn Roots is a magic effect per the tooltip. Free rooted allies with Naturalize, prioritizing the Bloodthirsty Gaze target if they're rooted
[광역 피해] Use Zephyr and Temporal Anomaly for Thorncaller Roar, and save the Rewind + Stasis combo for Lightcrazed Frenzy after 50%
[회피] If you're the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, gain distance with Hover and use only instants like Reversion and Echo
Lightwarden Ruia: [해제] Cauterizing Flame removes the Grievous Thrash bleed. Taking a Pulverizing Strikes cone (164870 Physical) with the bleed still up is dangerous, so clear the marked players first
[탱버] Against the repeated Warden's Wrath (48491 Nature) on the tank in Moonkin Form and Mangling Claws in Bear Form, keep Reversion on the tank and use Time Dilation
[광역 피해] Use Rewind and a Stasis combo for Spirits of the Vale after 40%
Ziekket: [광역 피해] Handle constant Oozing Xylem damage with Temporal Anomaly followed by a Reversion rotation, and use Emerald Blossom on Essence Burst procs
[탱버] If the Thornspike knockback (193965 Holy, then 58189 Physical bleed every 1 sec for 10 sec) pushes the tank beyond Verdant Embrace's 25 yd range, follow with Hover and cast Verdant Embrace

[탱버] When Lashers spawn the tank holds threat in the middle of the pack and Lightspore Shot (58189 Holy) usually targets the tank, so keep Reversion on the tank during this phase and knock up grouped pre-revive Lashers with Tail Swipe to stop their casts

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] Lay down Zephyr and Temporal Anomaly before the Ravenous Bellow cast, and cover the 10-sec DoT with Dream Breath right after
[해제] Clear Toxic Spores poison with Naturalize (8 sec). Start with the tank, who steps on the most mushrooms
Sentinel of Winter: [해제] Clear the Glacial Torment magic DoT with Naturalize
[광역 피해] During Frozen Tempest, aim the Dream Breath cone at the party stacked inside Snowdrift
[회피] Turn on Hover when moving to dodge Raging Squall so you can keep casting
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] Lay down Temporal Anomaly and start charging Dream Breath before the Overwhelming Onslaught triple hit (3 sec cast, 315193 armor-ignoring Physical every 1 sec). While you charge a healing empower spell, Unshakable stops the final hit's knockback from moving you
[광역 피해] Pop Zephyr on the party gathered around Zul'jarra during Fury of the War God and use Dream Breath and Emerald Blossom

[탱버] The three Echoing Maul targets take 193965 Nature within 8 yd when the Echo lands. Put Time Dilation on targets (2 charges for Chronowarden with Just in Time), and if you are a target, Hover to this set's assigned corner

Kystia Manaheart: [해제] Clear the 30-sec Corroding Spittle magic DoT with Naturalize
[광역 피해] Every 20-sec Destabilized, store Dream Breath, Temporal Anomaly, and Merithra's Blessing in Stasis and release them. Save Rewind (4 min) for the single worst hit
[제어] You have no interrupt, so stop the Mirror Images clones' Felstorm with Tail Swipe, Wing Buffet, or Sleep Walk
Zaen Bladesorrow: [해제] In the opening, when you drag in the worker pack and Keen Taskmaster's Back to Work! (enrage, 200% Warehouse Worker attack speed for 20 sec) lands, aim Oppressing Roar (1 min 30 sec with Overawe) at the workers to remove it, and use Time Dilation and Verdant Embrace on the tank
[해제] Clear the tank's Heartstop Poison after Envenom (30% max health reduction, 15 sec Nature DoT) right away with Naturalize
[광역 피해] Pop Zephyr for Killing Spree, and use Rewind if Fel-Infused Freight DoTs overlap it. Use Reversion and Verdant Embrace on players hit by Murder in a Row

[광역 피해] Use Zephyr and Temporal Anomaly before the AoE of Infernal Crush and the end of the Demonic Rage cast. On the second Demonic Rage, where Bloodlust is used, line up Rewind as well
Lithiel Cinderfury: [광역 피해] Handle constant Searing Fel Flame damage by repeating Temporal Anomaly then Reversion on cooldown
[위치] With 30-yard range, it's easy to fall behind the party after the Demonic Gateway. Follow right away with Hover
[제어] Knock up Wild Imp packs with Tail Swipe to interrupt Felfire Burst

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Lay down Zephyr and Temporal Anomaly right before Dark Bloom, and Rewind right after it lands
[위치] With 30-yard range, stand midway between the tank circling the walls and the party
Atroxus: [광역 피해] While the Toxic Creeper is alive, repeat Temporal Anomaly then Reversion on cooldown, and use Dream Breath right after Monstrous Roar
[탱버] Put Time Dilation on the tank to match the 2-sec Hulking Claw cast, and follow with Verdant Embrace if Sickening Bite stacks are high
[해제] Mind-Numbing Poison from Poison Splash and Poison Pool is a poison effect. Clear party members with the 30% haste reduction using Naturalize
Charonus: [광역 피해] Lay down Dream Breath and Reversion for the 20 sec Cosmic Crash DoT

[참고] Gravitic Orbs targets drag their orbs out toward separate Singularities, so put Reversion and Echo on them in advance. In this window, when damage spikes as they cross the pools, use Rewind, which reaches everyone within 40 yd, instead of Zephyr (4 allies within 20 yd), which cannot reach spread targets
[위치] If you are a Gravitic Orbs target, drag the orb to the far Singularity assigned to ranged, casting Temporal Anomaly on the move with Hover. If a Singularity pulls you in, Hover out

The Golden Serpent: [광역 피해] Use Zephyr and lay down Temporal Anomaly before Serpentine Gust
[참고] Put Reversion on the Spit Gold target to cover the 6-sec Fire DoT
Mchimba the Embalmer: [해제] Clear the Wretched Discharge disease with Cauterizing Flame. It's on a 1-min cooldown, so use it on the most endangered target
[광역 피해] Use Dream Breath right after Awakening Slam, and top the Drain Fluids target above 90% with Verdant Embrace to remove Desiccation
The Council of Tribes: [해제] Clear Kula's Severing Axe bleed with Cauterizing Flame
[해제] When Zanazal's Poison Nova poison lands, dispel one at a time with Naturalize while Dream Breath keeps the party up
[탱버] Put Time Dilation on the tank for the 10-sec Shattered Defenses
Dazar, The First King: [광역 피해] Rewind right after the Gilded Destruction burst, and cover the 15-sec DoT with Dream Breath and Temporal Anomaly stored in Stasis
[해제] Clear T'zala's Savage Maul bleed from the tank with Cauterizing Flame
[탱버] Put Time Dilation on the tank for the Blade Combo after Savage Maul

Melidrussa Chillworn: [광역 피해] Lay down Temporal Anomaly right before the Chillstorm explosion, and in the Frost Overload intermission pop Zephyr and repeat Dream Breath and Emerald Blossom

[참고] The tank interrupts Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice lands and drags the boss off the ice. Keep Reversion on the tank while they move, and if the kick is missed, put Time Dilation on the tank

[해제] Infused Whelp's Cold Claws is a Magic effect that becomes Frozen Solid at 20 stacks. With many whelps, a player can reach 20 stacks before Naturalize (8 sec) is back, so clear the highest-stacked player first
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] Put Time Dilation on the tank before the Searing Blows 4-hit combo, and cover the stacking Searing Wounds DoT with Reversion
[광역 피해] Cycle Temporal Anomaly then Reversion for stacking Inferno damage, and use Rewind when stacks get high
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [참고] Near the end of Interrupting Cloudburst, stop casts and empower spells like Living Flame, Temporal Anomaly, and Dream Breath, and use instants like Reversion, Echo, and Verdant Embrace
[광역 피해] Dump the Stasis combo and Rewind at the start of phase 2

[해제] The Stormslam debuff (381515) is a Magic effect, so clear it with Naturalize before the next Stormslam. Save Time Dilation for the Inferno Spit target, right before the circle fades and explodes, not for Stormslam

Adderis & Aspix: [광역 피해] Lay down Temporal Anomaly right before the party stacks to soak Thunder and Lightning, and aim the Dream Breath cone at the stack
[참고] Put Reversion on the Gust target to cover the 4-sec DoT
[위치] The boss stands in the middle of the room, so if Gale Force pushes you away, Hover straight back to the melee group to share the Thunder and Lightning damage
Merektha: [해제] Clear the Toxic Viper's Poison Spit poison with Naturalize
[광역 피해] Use Zephyr and Dream Breath for Serpentstorm
[제어] Knock up snakes grouped by A Knot of Snakes with Tail Swipe or root them with Landslide
Galvazzt: [참고] Keep Reversion on the beam soakers, and put Time Dilation on a soaker with high Galvanized stacks
[광역 피해] Lay down Temporal Anomaly before the Induction AoE damage
Avatar of Sethraliss: [참고] For 30 sec after the Essence Defiler dies, fill the Avatar with targeted heals (Verdant Embrace, Living Flame, Reversion, Echo)
[제어] Root the Faithless Tormentor chasing the healer with Landslide, or push it away with Tail Swipe and Wing Buffet

Verdant Embrace consumes 4 sec of Dream Breath from allies it heals, detonating it and healing them for 240% of the amount consumed.

Emerald Blossom and Fluttering Seedlings consume 2 sec of Dream Breath from allies they heal, detonating it and healing them for 240% of the amount consumed.

444322.d: Obsidian Scales also applies to your target or 1 nearby injured ally at 50% value.

1241669.d: Verdant Embrace healing is increased by 40%. In addition, it no longer causes you to leap to your target, instead sending forth a Dream Simulacrum.

1242031.d: Casting Emerald Blossom causes your next Echo to cast on an additional ally within 25 yards at 100% effectiveness. Stacks up to 2 charges.

1256581.m: 1.54% of base mana · 30 yd range · Instant
1256581.d: Spring a bloom of life from your target, healing them and up to 4 other allies within 30 yards for (225% of Spell Power). Blooms may heal your primary target multiple times if no nearby injured allies are present.

1256689.d: Dream Breath's healing is increased by 60% and Dream Breath has a 100% chance to grant Merithra's Blessing.

1260484.d: Tip the Scales' cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

1264269.d: Dream Breath and Fire Breath gain an additional charge.

1265979.d: Consuming Essence Burst fires a twin flame, healing your target for (312% of Spell Power).

1265992.d: Twin Flame bounces to up to 2 additional targets.

1265993.d: Dream Breath and Fire Breath have a 50% chance to generate Essence Burst.

1239581.d: Your empower spells are 10% more effective. While charging a healing empower spell, you cannot be knocked back.

351338.m: 특성 · 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간
351338.d: 적의 주문 시전을 방해하고 6초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하도록 만듭니다.

355913.m: 3 정수 / 15% (기본 마나 중) · 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
355913.d: 대상 아군의 위치에 에메랄드의 꿈의 구근을 자라나게 합니다. 1.5초 후에 10미터 내에 있는 최대 3명의 부상당한 아군을 (주문력의 323%)만큼 치유합니다.

355936.m: 특성 · 4.9% (기본 마나 중) · 집중 (2.5 초 주문 시전 시간) · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
355936.d:
숨을 들이마셔 꿈의 힘을 모읍니다. 숨을 방출하면 자신과 전방 40미터 부채꼴 범위 내에 있는 5명의 부상당한 아군을 [(주문력의 92.16%) + (주문력의 53.52%) * (8 + 0)]만큼 치유합니다.

I: 즉시 (주문력의 92.16%)만큼 치유하고 (16 + 0)초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 53.52%) * (8 + 0)]의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

II: 즉시 [(주문력의 92.16%) + (주문력의 53.52%) * 2]만큼 치유하고 (12 + 0)초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 53.52%) * (6 + 0)]의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

III: 즉시 [(주문력의 92.16%) + (주문력의 53.52%) * 4]만큼 치유하고 (8 + 0)초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 53.52%) * (4 + 0)]의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

356995.m: 3 정수 · 25 야드 사정거리 · 집중 (3 초 주문 시전 시간)
356995.d: 작렬하는 푸른색 마법으로 적을 찢어 3초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 475.53%)의 비전냉기 피해를 입히고 3초 동안 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

357170.m: 특성 · 2.2% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
357170.d: 다음 8초 동안 아군 주위의 시간을 팽창시켜 대상이 받는 피해의 50%를 8초에 걸쳐 받게 합니다.

357208.m: 1.8% (기본 마나 중) · 집중 (2.5 초 주문 시전 시간) · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
357208.d:
숨을 들이쉬면서 내면의 불꽃을 지핍니다. 숨 방출 시 전방 부채꼴 범위 내의 적을 불태워 [((주문력의 163.409%)) + ((주문력의 39.4834%) * (10 + 0 + 0))]의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

강화 시 지속 피해가 아닌 즉시 피해가 증가합니다.

I: 즉시 [(주문력의 163.409%)]의 피해를 입히고 (20 + 0 + 0)초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 39.4834%) * (10 + 0 + 0)]의 피해를 입힙니다.

II: 즉시 [(주문력의 163.409%) + ((주문력의 39.4834%) * 3)]의 피해를 입히고 (14 + 0 + 0)초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 39.4834%) * (7 + 0 + 0)]의 피해를 입힙니다.

III: 즉시 [(주문력의 163.409%) + ((주문력의 39.4834%) * 6)]의 피해를 입히고 (8 + 0 + 0)초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 39.4834%) * (4 + 0 + 0)]의 피해를 입힙니다.

357210.m: 15 - 50 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
357210.d:
숨을 깊이 들이마신 후, 대상 위치로 날아가며 이동 경로 밑에 있는 적에게 녹아내린 잿불을 내뿜어 (주문력의 520%)의 화산 피해를 입힙니다.

모든 이동 불가 효과를 제거합니다. 비행 중에는 이동 방해 및 제어 불가 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

357214.d: 날개를 힘껏 펄럭여 전방의 적을 밀쳐냅니다.

358267.m: 즉시 · 35 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
358267.d:
도약하여 (6 + 0)초 동안 이동 속도가 30%만큼 증가합니다.

이동하면서 기원사 주문을 시전할 수 있으며, 시전 중에도 시전할 수 있습니다. 강화된 주문에는 영향을 주지 않습니다.

358385.m: 특성 · 1.4% (기본 마나 중) · 10 - 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
358385.d: 대상 위치를 향해 변화하는 돌의 길을 창조해 적을 15초 동안 이동 불가 상태로 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 받으면 효과가 해제될 수 있습니다.

360806.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 25 야드 사정거리 · 1.7 초 주문 시전 시간
360806.d: 적이 20초 동안 방향 감각을 상실하고 잠에 빠져 자신을 향해 다가오게 합니다. 피해를 받으면 일정 확률로 잠에서 깨어납니다.

360823.m: 1.4% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간
360823.d: 대상에게 걸린 해로운 효과를 정화하여, 모든 마법 및 독 효과를 제거합니다.

360995.m: 특성 · 10% (기본 마나 중) · 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 24 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
360995.d: 아군에게 날아가 (주문력의 1719%)의 생명력을 회복시키거나, 자신의 생명력을 동일한 양만큼 회복시킵니다.

361227.m: 0.8% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 10 초 주문 시전 시간
361227.d: 죽은 파티원을 되살립니다. 대상은 35%의 생명력과 마나를 지닌 채로 되살아납니다. 전투 중에는 사용할 수 없습니다.

361469.m: 12% (기본 마나 중) · 25 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간
361469.d: 대상에게 명멸하는 불꽃을 보내 아군을 (주문력의 780%)만큼 치유하거나 적에게 (주문력의 232.001%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

363534.m: 특성 · 5.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 4 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
363534.d:
40미터 내의 모든 아군이 지난 5초 동안 받은 피해의 30%를 되돌립니다. 항상 최소 (주문력 * 0.4 * 5)의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

공격대에 속해 있지 않을 때는 치유량이 200%만큼 증가합니다.

363916.m: 특성 · 300 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
363916.d: 비늘을 강화해 받는 피해가 30%만큼 감소합니다. [소생의 불길: 추가로 8초에 걸쳐 방지한 피해만큼 생명력을 회복합니다] 12초 동안 지속됩니다.

364342.m: 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
364342.d: 시간의 실타래를 엮어 1시간 동안 모든 파티원과 공격대원의 주요 이동 능력의 재사용 대기시간을 15%만큼 감소시킵니다.

364343.m: 특성 · 2 정수 / 1.9% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
364343.d: 시간의 마력으로 아군을 감싸 (주문력의 240%)의 생명력을 회복시킵니다. 또한 다음 치유 주문이 해당 아군에게 추가로 시전되어 일반 치유량의 [ceil(70 / 시간의 군주: 105 / 황금빛 기회: 77)]%에 해당하는 생명력을 회복시킵니다. 정수 주문은 메아리를 발동시키지 않습니다.

366155.m: 특성 · 2.2% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 9 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
366155.d:
아군의 부상을 되돌려 [사활의 순간: 지난 5초 동안 받은 피해의 15%만큼 즉시 치유하고, 추가로] 12초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 256.5%)만큼 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

되감기가 극대화 효과를 발휘하면 지속시간이 2초만큼 증가하여, 최대 12초만큼 증가합니다.

368970.d: 꼬리를 휘둘러 8미터 내에 있는 적을 공중으로 날려 보냅니다.

369297.d: 살아있는 불꽃 사용 시 20%의 확률로, 되감기 사용 시 15%의 확률로 다음 정수 능력이 정수를 소모하지 않습니다. [정수의 조화: 1번까지 중첩됩니다]

370537.m: 특성 · 4% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
370537.d: 다음 3회의 이로운 주문을 복제하여 고정된 시간에 저장합니다. 30초 안에 정지장을 다시 활성화하면 저장한 주문을 빠르게 방출합니다.

370553.d: 시간을 압축합니다. 다음 강화된 주문은 최대 강화 단계가 되며 즉시 시전됩니다.

370665.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
370665.d: 아군에게 강하하여 대상 위치까지 함께 비행합니다. 자신과 아군에게 걸린 이동 방해 효과를 제거합니다.

371426.d: 불의 숨결과 깊은 숨결이 주위의 부상당한 아군 5명을 최대 5명의 대상에게 입힌 피해의 80%만큼 나누어 치유합니다.

372048.d: 전방 부채꼴 범위의 적에게 뼛속까지 흔들리는 포효를 내질러 다음 10초 동안 대상에게 영향을 주는 군중 제어 효과의 지속시간을 50%만큼 증가시킵니다. [위압: 각각의 적에게서 1개의 격노 효과를 제거합니다]

372233.d: 파열의 공격력이 35%만큼 증가합니다. 또한 지속시간에 걸쳐 (2700 * 4)의 마나를 생성합니다. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

373270.d: 신록의 품이 일시적으로 자신의 생명력을 아군과 결속시킵니다. 자신이나 아군이 치유를 받으면 결속된 대상의 생명력을 받는 치유 효과의 60%만큼 회복시킵니다. 8초 동안 지속됩니다.

373861.m: 특성 · 7.5% (기본 마나 중) · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
373861.d:
전방으로 시간 마력의 소용돌이를 내보내 자신과 경로에 있는 아군이 받는 피해를 [주문력 * 6 * (1 + 유연성)]만큼 흡수합니다. 5명을 넘는 대상에게는 피해 흡수 효과가 감소합니다.

처음 통과하는 5명의 아군에게 30%의 효율로 메아리를 부여합니다.

374227.d: 상승 기류를 일으켜 자신 및 20미터 내의 가장 가까운 아군 4명을 공중으로 띄워 올립니다. 공중에 뜬 동안 8초 동안 광역 공격으로 받는 피해가 20%만큼 감소하고 이동 속도는 30%만큼 증가합니다.

374251.m: 특성 · 10% (기본 마나 중) · 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
374251.d: 아군의 상처를 소작해 모든 출혈, 독, 저주, 질병 효과를 제거합니다. 효과를 제거한 후 (주문력의 350%)만큼 치유합니다.

374346.d: 탄압의 포효가 각각의 적에게서 1개의 격노 효과를 제거합니다. 추가로 재사용 대기시간이 30초만큼 감소합니다.

374348.d: 흑요석 비늘 사용 시 소생의 불길로 감싸여, 방지한 피해의 100%만큼 8초에 걸쳐 회복합니다.

376204.d: 시간 팽창이 1회 추가로 충전됩니다. 또한 재사용 대기시간이 10초만큼 감소합니다.

376239.d: 자신의 되감기가 부여된 대상에 대한 치유량이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

378196.d: 되감기 시전 시 즉시 대상이 지난 5초 동안 받은 피해의 15%만큼 치유합니다.

429483.d:
부양 시전 시 일시적으로 공간을 왜곡해 목표 지점에서 나타납니다. 추가로 부양의 재사용 대기시간이 5초만큼 감소합니다.

부양으로 이동하는 동안 기원사 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다.

431442.d: 살아있는 불꽃이 청동 마법으로 강화되어, 지난 5초 동안 대상에게 입힌 피해 또는 치유량을 15%만큼, 최대 [(주문력 * 2.5) * (1 + 유연성)]만큼 비전 효과로 반복 적용합니다.

431657.d: 신록의 품으로 부여된 지속 치유 효과 하나당 가속이 3%만큼, 최대 9%만큼 증가합니다.

431695.d: 전세역전의 효과로 시간의 마력이 과부하되어 가속과 이동 속도, 재사용 대기시간 회복 속도가 30%만큼 증가합니다. 이 효과는 30초에 걸쳐 점점 감소합니다.

431715.d: 시간 변칙의 마나 소모량이 15%만큼, 재사용 대기시간은 4초만큼 감소합니다.

443177.d: 되감기로 생명력을 회복시키면 일정 확률로 다음 살아있는 불꽃이 즉시 시전되고 공격력 또는 치유량이 100%만큼 증가합니다. 최대 2회까지 충전됩니다.

444088.d:
신록의 품 사용 시 아군에게 부여된 꿈의 숨결 지속시간의 4초를 소모하여, 폭발을 일으켜 소모량의 240%에 해당하는 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

에메랄드 꽃과 팔랑이는 묘목 사용 시 아군에게 부여된 꿈의 숨결 지속시간의 2초를 소모하여, 폭발을 일으켜 소모량의 240%에 해당하는 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

1241669.d: 신록의 품의 치유량이 40%만큼 증가합니다. 추가로 더는 대상에게 도약하지 않고 꿈의 복제를 내보냅니다.

1242031.d: 에메랄드 꽃 시전 시 다음 메아리가 25미터 내의 추가 아군 한 명에게 100%의 효율로 시전됩니다. 최대 2번까지 충전됩니다.

1256581.d: 대상에게 생명의 꽃을 피워내 대상과 30미터 내 최대 4명의 다른 아군을 (주문력의 225%)만큼 치유합니다. 꽃은 주위에 부상당한 아군이 없으면 주 대상을 여러 번 치유합니다.

1256689.d: 꿈의 숨결의 치유량이 60%만큼 증가합니다. 또한 꿈의 숨결이 100%의 확률로 메리스라의 축복을 부여합니다.

1264269.d: 꿈의 숨결과 불의 숨결이 추가로 1회 충전됩니다.

1265979.d: 정수 폭발을 소모하면 쌍둥이 불길을 방출해 대상을 (주문력의 312%)만큼 치유합니다.

1265992.d: 쌍둥이 불길이 최대 2명의 추가 대상에게 튕깁니다.

1265993.d: 꿈의 숨결과 불의 숨결 사용 시 50%의 확률로 정수 폭발을 생성합니다.

1239581.d: 강화 주문의 효과가 10%만큼 증가합니다. 치유 강화 주문에 정신을 집중하는 동안에는 뒤로 밀쳐지지 않습니다.

1: [광역 피해] This is the Bloodlust pull, so pop Zephyr (2 min) right before Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec) and lay down Dream Breath. Right after the damage spike, use Rewind (4 min) to rewind 30% of the last 5 sec of damage.
[제어] If Radiant Spellsower runs to a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove, root it for 15 sec with Landslide (1 min 30 sec) or Sleep Walk it so it walks back to you.
2: [광역 피해] Zephyr from pull 1 is not back yet, so answer Spouting Floret by releasing Dream Breath → Temporal Anomaly → Merithra's Blessing stored in Stasis (1 min 30 sec).

[차단] When both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley (174568 Holy to the party, 4 sec cast), knock both up next to the tank with Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep). If only one is left, use Wing Buffet (1 min with Heavy Wingbeats).
3: [탱버] If Time Dilation (1 min) used on Earthrupture Strike in pull 1 is not back, Chronowarden spends the second charge from Just in Time, and Flameshaper uses Verdant Embrace right after the hit.
[회피] When Virid Grovekeeper casts Uproot (3 sec cast, knockback), start charging Dream Breath. Unshakable stops you from being knocked back while charging a healing empower spell.
5: [광역 피해] Sporeblight Belcher is pulled first, so use Temporal Anomaly and Dream Breath on Spouting Floret, and save Verdant Embrace for Earthrupture Strike from the Virid Grovekeeper that joins 5-6 sec later.
[차단] Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec disorient) stops your healing, so stop the cast with Wing Buffet or Tail Swipe.
7: [탱버] Two Luminous Thornmaws alternate Grievous Gash (387930 Physical). Chronowarden has 2 Time Dilation charges from Just in Time, so use one per Thornmaw. Flameshaper targets the tank and uses Obsidian Scales on the second Gash so Lifecinders gives the tank 50% of the effect.

[탱버] The Grievous Gash bleed (48491 Physical every 1 sec for 16 sec, stacking) only drops at full health. Top the tank off in one go with Verdant Embrace (24 sec), then finish with Reversion, which instantly heals 15% of the last 5 sec of damage through Golden Hour.
[차단] Stop Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Tail Swipe or Wing Buffet, and heal from outside the Solar Breath (387930 Holy) frontal cone.
10: [해제] Toxic Spew is a poison that deals 58189 Nature every 1.5 sec for 9 sec to the whole party. Clear the two lowest players with Naturalize (8 sec) and Cauterizing Flame (1 min), and heal the rest with Dream Breath.
[광역 피해] Lay down a Temporal Anomaly shield as Toxic Spew is cast (2 sec), and put Reversion on players you could not dispel to carry them through the 9 sec of poison damage.
11: [탱버] Luminous Thornmaw's Grievous Gash bleed only drops at full health, so top the tank all the way off with Verdant Embrace and Reversion. If it overlaps Spouting Floret, delay the tank's damage with Time Dilation while you heal the party with Dream Breath.
[차단] You cannot stop all three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech with one button, so knock up the gathered birds with Tail Swipe and stop the last one with Wing Buffet.
12: [광역 피해] This is the last big pull, so pop Zephyr and Stasis when Spouting Floret overlaps Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley, and use Rewind (4 min) right after the spike if it is back.
[참고] A Lightgorged Lasher shielded by Lightbloom Pollination is immune to crowd control, so Tail Swipe will not land on it. Save Tail Swipe for Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley.

1: [해제] Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (48491 Nature every 1 sec for 20 sec, 10% slow per tick) is a Magic effect, so Naturalize (8 sec) removes it. Clear the most-slowed target first, and put Reversion on anyone hit while Naturalize is on cooldown.

[차단] If the group lacks kicks for the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss, knock them up with Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep). If one goes through and the tank loses 30% haste for 6 sec, put both Reversion charges on the tank and add Time Dilation.
2: [광역 피해] Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice hits instantly with no cast, dealing 87284 Physical to the whole party and absorbing the next 162029 healing. Send Temporal Anomaly (15 sec) on cooldown while the Chieftain is alive to keep the shield up, and right after the hit use Tip the Scales (2 min, 1 min 30 sec for Chronowarden with Chronoboon) to release Dream Breath instantly at max rank and burn the heal absorb.

[광역 피해] Pulls 2, 3, 4 and 5 all have a Chieftain, so Blood Sacrifice comes every pull. Do not stack big cooldowns in one pull; assign them one at a time: pull 2 Tip the Scales → pull 3 Stasis (1 min 30 sec) → pull 4 Tip the Scales (if back) → pull 5 Rewind (4 min).
3: [광역 피해] For Blood Sacrifice, store Dream Breath → Verdant Embrace → Emerald Blossom in Stasis and release them all the moment the heal absorb lands.

[위치] When the tank breaks line of sight behind the pillar, stand behind it too and avoid Fetid Spit until the three Primal Serpents walk in. Once they are grouped, knock them up together with Tail Swipe to stop one Piercing Hiss.
4: [광역 피해] If Tip the Scales from pull 2 is back, release Dream Breath instantly at max rank again right after Blood Sacrifice. If not, burn the heal absorbs on several players with Emerald Blossom and Echo.
5: [광역 피해] This is the most painful trash pull on the route: two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots DoTs overlap Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice. Use Rewind (4 min) right after Blood Sacrifice to rewind 30% of the last 5 sec of damage, together with Zephyr or Stasis if it is back.

[해제] Naturalize (8 sec) can only clear Paralyzing Shots from one player every 8 sec. Cauterizing Flame does not remove Magic, so do not spend it here; keep undispelled targets up with Reversion empowered by Golden Hour.
[회피] When you move out of the Toxic Breath frontal, pop Hover (35 sec) so you can cast Temporal Anomaly (1.5 sec cast) and Living Flame on the move.
7: [광역 피해] When Rattling Writhe casts Rattle (3 sec cast; 58189 armor-ignoring Physical every 1 sec for 5 sec), send Temporal Anomaly through the stacked party and lay down Dream Breath. If anyone has the Envenom poison, clear it with Naturalize before Rattle lands.
[탱버] When the tank takes Corrosive Fangs (242456 Nature, 20% increased damage taken for 20 sec), top them off at once with Verdant Embrace (24 sec) and keep Reversion on them for the 20 sec.
9: [차단] Stop whichever of the two High Evolutionists starts Evolve (6 sec channel) with Tail Swipe or Wing Buffet (1 min with Heavy Wingbeats). If the channel finishes, it gains a shield and crowd control immunity.
[광역 피해] Mass Envenom (24246 Nature every 1 sec for 8 sec) is not dispellable, so heal through it with Dream Breath, and pop Zephyr if it overlaps Rattle.
11: [해제] When the four High Evolutionists' Envenom poison lands on several players, clear one with Naturalize (8 sec) and another with Cauterizing Flame (1 min). Cauterizing Flame also heals as it removes the poison.
[차단] If the tank groups all four, knock several up with Tail Swipe to stop their Evolve channels, and stop the last one with Wing Buffet.
12: [광역 피해] Ascendant Serpent's Infest (34914 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yd on expiry) stacks the egg bursts when the party gathers on the tank's marked spot. Send Temporal Anomaly to that spot as the party gathers, and heal everyone at once with the Dream Breath cone.
[탱버] The tank gets pushed back during Noxious Spray (67888 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec), so put Time Dilation on them and keep them within Verdant Embrace's 25 yd range.
13: [광역 피해] When Ula'tek's Chosen casts Toxic Surge (2 sec cast; 29095 Nature to the party every 1 sec for 9 sec), pop Zephyr (8 sec). While dodging the Toxic Beam lines, pop Hover so you can cast Temporal Anomaly on the move.
[광역 피해] Living Venoms deal party damage with Venom Burst when they die, so if several of the six are low at once, send Temporal Anomaly in advance.
14: [광역 피해] Zephyr from pull 13 is not back yet, so release Dream Breath → Temporal Anomaly → Emerald Blossom stored in Stasis for Toxic Surge, and use Rewind late in Toxic Surge if you still have it.
15: [해제] Clear Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots with Naturalize. If a player also has Blade of the Altar behind them from Laced Edge, clear that player first.
16: [광역 피해] Two Ritual Chieftains chain Blood Sacrifice and Ula'tek's Chosen adds Toxic Surge, so this is the heaviest healing pull. Use a Tip the Scales Dream Breath right after the first Blood Sacrifice, Zephyr on the Toxic Surge cast (2 sec), Rewind right after the second Blood Sacrifice, and release Stasis on the remaining damage.
[참고] Flameshaper pops Obsidian Scales (1 min 30 sec) so Lifecinders gives a low-health ally 50% of the effect, and both builds heal back the damage prevented over 8 sec through Renewing Blaze.

1: [탱버] This is the Bloodlust pull with Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together, so tankbusters overlap. A tank hit by Shield Bash takes 20% more Physical damage for 20 sec, so keep Reversion on them during that time and put Time Dilation on the next big hit. Chronowarden spends one Just in Time charge on the Captain and one on the Guard, and Flameshaper targets the tank and pops Obsidian Scales so Lifecinders gives them 50% of the effect.

[해제] If one player has both Row Hooligan's Cutpurse (155172 Bleed over 8 sec) and Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison, remove both at once with Cauterizing Flame (1 min). Clear players with only the poison with Naturalize (8 sec).
2: [차단] Assign one player per Seductive Sayaad for Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient). You have no interrupt, so take one with Wing Buffet (1 min with Heavy Wingbeats) or Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep).
4: [해제] With four Street Sneaks, Heartstop Poison (5% max health reduction per stack, 193965 Nature over 8 sec) stacks quickly on the tank. Use Naturalize (8 sec) on the tank on cooldown, and clear it once more with Cauterizing Flame in between.
5: [해제] Massive Felwyrm's Corroding Spittle (106681 Fire every 3 sec for 30 sec) is a Magic effect, so clear it right away with Naturalize. It is the most painful DoT in this pull.
[광역 피해] While Massive Felwyrm is alive, Over-infused triggers Burning Fel (38793 Fire to the party) every 3 sec, so send Temporal Anomaly on cooldown and keep Dream Breath going.
8: [광역 피해] When Shivan Punisher starts Demonic Frenzy below 50% health (29095 Fire to the party every 1 sec until it dies), pop Zephyr (2 min) and lay down Dream Breath. If the kill is slow, add Rewind (4 min).
[해제] If a kick on Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (enrage, 60% damage reduction, crowd control immunity) is missed, remove it with Oppressing Roar (1 min 30 sec with Overawe).
9: [해제] Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom (581895 Shadow after 10 sec) is a curse, so remove it at once with Cauterizing Flame (1 min). If it is on cooldown, gather the party within 4 yd of the target to split the damage and send Temporal Anomaly there.

[참고] If the Drain Life target cannot use a defensive, put Time Dilation on them and fill them with Verdant Embrace so the warlock does not heal much. If Wrathguard Flayer has Fel Rage and Oppressing Roar is back, remove it.
10: [광역 피해] When Shivan Punisher starts Demonic Frenzy, release Dream Breath → Temporal Anomaly → Emerald Blossom stored in Stasis (1 min 30 sec), and pop Zephyr too if it is back from pull 8.
11: [광역 피해] Split cooldowns one per cast for Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (2 sec cast; 43642 Fire to the party every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec). Use Zephyr on the first, a Tip the Scales (2 min, 1 min 30 sec for Chronowarden with Chronoboon) Dream Breath on the second, and Rewind if it reaches a third.
[회피] Dodge the Eye Beam frontal away from the party, and pop Hover while dodging so you can cast Temporal Anomaly on the move.
13: [광역 피해] Pop Zephyr for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (2 sec cast, 145474 Fire to the party), and put Reversion on players hit by the nearby Defiled Detonations (193965 Shadow).
[해제] If either Wrathguard Flayer has Fel Rage, remove it with Oppressing Roar (Overawe). If both have it, catch them in one cone.
15: [해제] While the group pulls Corrupted Warlock back and kills it first, remove Curse of Doom at once with Cauterizing Flame. Save Zephyr or Stasis for Demonic Frenzy when Shivan Punisher is fought separately.
16: [광역 피해] Finish Defiled Golem within two AoEs and assign two party defensives (Topicx). Use Zephyr on the first Defiled Slam and Rewind or Stasis on the second. If you used Zephyr in pull 13, swap the order and use Stasis on the first.

1: [해제] Clear the two Territorial Matriarchs' Mother's Wrath enrage (50% increased damage, stacking) by aiming Oppressing Roar (1 min 30 sec with Overawe) as a cone at both, removing one enrage from each. If someone else soothes too, split the order around the second enrage.

[해제] Spirit of Hunger's totem casts Insatiable Hunger, a curse (15% max health reduction, stacking), which Cauterizing Flame (1 min) removes. Cauterizing Flame also removes Keen-Eyed Striker's Razor Dive bleed (33944 Physical every 1 sec for 10 sec, stacking), so use it first on whichever has more stacks.

[광역 피해] This is the Bloodlust and cooldown pull. When the Feast of Misery channel starts (38793 Shadow every 1 sec for 5 sec), pop Zephyr (2 min) and lay down Dream Breath, and use Rewind (4 min) when health drops while Insatiable Hunger has cut max health.
2: [해제] Before Insatiable Hunger reaches 2 stacks, clear the most endangered player with Cauterizing Flame. If Cauterizing Flame from pull 1 is not back, cushion Feast of Misery with Temporal Anomaly.
4: [해제] If the three Keen-Eyed Strikers stack Razor Dive bleeds on one player, clear them with Cauterizing Flame, and carry the other targets with Reversion empowered by Golden Hour.
[광역 피해] For the Feast of Misery channel, release Dream Breath → Verdant Embrace → Emerald Blossom stored in Stasis (1 min 30 sec).
7: [해제] This is the cooldown pull after the boss, with two Territorial Matriarchs. If Oppressing Roar from pull 1 is back, catch both in the cone to remove Mother's Wrath; if not, put Time Dilation on the tank to delay damage during the enrage stacks.
[광역 피해] Use Zephyr and a Tip the Scales (2 min, 1 min 30 sec for Chronowarden with Chronoboon) Dream Breath here now that they are back.
8: [광역 피해] Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward deals 24246 Nature to the whole party every 2 sec until the shield breaks. If the shield lasts, send Temporal Anomaly on cooldown and keep Reversion rolling on the party.

[탱버] Two Matriarchs' enrage and Frostfang's Frostbite (67888 Frost) pile onto the tank. Oppressing Roar from pull 7 is not back, so support the tank with Time Dilation and Verdant Embrace, and Flameshaper targets the tank and pops Obsidian Scales so Lifecinders gives them 50% of the effect.
9: [해제] Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge is a Magic effect, so Naturalize (8 sec) removes it. Damage (48491) spreads to players within 4 yd, so clear targets standing in the melee pack first.
[광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull. Pop Zephyr for Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward damage, and put Time Dilation on the tank during Frostfang's Bloodrush (60% attack speed for 10 sec).
10: [해제] Two Glacial Revenants can apply Cryo Surge every 5 sec, so save Naturalize (8 sec) for these targets only. Take the second target out of the group with Rescue so the 4 yd damage does not spread.

[차단] Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% haste and movement speed reduction) slows your healing badly, so if a kick is missed, stop it with Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep) or Wing Buffet (1 min with Heavy Wingbeats).
11: [광역 피해] Avatar of Determination's Glacial Tomb deals 38793 Frost every 2 sec until broken. When you see the cast (2 sec), send Temporal Anomaly through the party, and put Reversion out beforehand so it keeps healing while players are encased.
[해제] Clear the accompanying Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge with Naturalize, and support the party with Dream Breath while Terra Rumbler's shield holds.
13: [광역 피해] The two Grizzled Warbringers alternate Primal Echo (armor-ignoring Physical, stacking), so send Temporal Anomaly for each Echo and pop Zephyr if the second Echo stacks on top. If Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem is alive, Fire damage adds on, so keep Dream Breath going.
14: [해제] When a Bonded Beasttamer's pet chases a player with the Bestial Wrath enrage (25% increased damage for 10 sec), remove it with Oppressing Roar (Overawe) and put Time Dilation on the chased player.

[광역 피해] Two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems (36368 Fire every 0.3 sec) stack damage fast. Hold with Dream Breath and Temporal Anomaly until the totems die, and if the third Bloodlust is used here, add Rewind.
15: [광역 피해] Four Grizzled Warbringers alternate Primal Echo, so do not dump big cooldowns into one Echo. Use Zephyr on the first Echo, Dream Breath → Temporal Anomaly → Emerald Blossom stored in Stasis on the second, and a Tip the Scales Dream Breath on the third, then top the party up with Reversion before the next Echo.
[참고] Use Rewind right after the biggest overlap of Echoes to rewind 30% of the last 5 sec of damage.

1: [광역 피해] This is the Bloodlust pull. Voidtouched Magi casts Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yd) back to back, so send Temporal Anomaly for the first cast, and if a kick is missed pop Zephyr (2 min) and lay down Dream Breath.
[해제] When Feral Saberon's Savage Leap bleed (38793 Physical every 1 sec for 5 sec) stacks on the tank, clear it with Cauterizing Flame (1 min), and add Time Dilation if big hits overlap.

[참고] A Null Eruption target who leaves the group takes the 10 yd pool damage (38793 Shadow every 1 sec for 5 sec) alone, so put Reversion on them, and if they leave your range, Hover after them and cast Verdant Embrace.
2: [광역 피해] Raj'kess the Spellstorm's Thundering Storm is long party damage. Use Zephyr and Temporal Anomaly on the cast (3 sec), and as it ends, use Rewind (4 min) to rewind 30% of the last 5 sec of damage.

[참고] If any Orb of Disruption cast completes and the party loses a lot of haste, Dream Breath charges slowly, so use Tip the Scales (2 min, 1 min 30 sec for Chronowarden with Chronoboon) to release Dream Breath instantly at max rank.
3: [광역 피해] Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (10 sec channel, 87284 Nature to the party every 2 sec) is the most painful part of this pull. When the channel starts, use Zephyr (8 sec) and Dream Breath, and at the end of the channel release Temporal Anomaly → Verdant Embrace → Emerald Blossom stored in Stasis.

[해제] Clear the five Feral Saberons' Savage Leap bleeds on the tank first with Cauterizing Flame, and clear Sycophantic Tarasek's Melt Armor (Magic debuff on the tank, 10% increased Fire damage taken) with Naturalize (8 sec).
[광역 피해] When you see Angry Krolusk's Violent Sand (3 sec cast, 155172 Nature to the party, 40% slow for 12 sec), send Temporal Anomaly through the party in advance.
5: [광역 피해] For Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike (5 sec cast, 872842 Nature shared within 10 yd), send Temporal Anomaly through the party gathered in the circle, and fill them with Dream Breath right after they land from the knock-up.

[차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) stops your healing for 6 sec. If a kick is missed, stop it with Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep) or Wing Buffet (1 min with Heavy Wingbeats).
6: [광역 피해] Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams deals 48491 Physical to the party every 1.5 sec until its shield breaks, 10% stronger with each slam. Hold the early slams with Temporal Anomaly and Reversion, and release Zephyr and Stasis once the stacks build up.
[광역 피해] If Brutal Slams overlaps Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak, use Rewind right after Sky Strike to rewind both.
8: [광역 피해] When Devouring Brutalizer casts Dreadbellow (4.5 sec cast, knockback, 29095 Shadow to the party every 1 sec for 12 sec, not dispellable), start charging Dream Breath. Unshakable stops the knockback while you charge a healing empower spell, so you can cover the 12 sec DoT right after the knockback.

[탱버] Brutalize (678877 Physical every 1.5 sec for 6 sec) always follows Dreadbellow, so as soon as Dream Breath is released, put Time Dilation on the tank and fill them with Verdant Embrace. Flameshaper targets the tank and pops Obsidian Scales so Lifecinders adds 50% of the effect.
[해제] Clear the three Sycophantic Tarasek's Melt Armor with Naturalize, but put it behind stopping Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek and helping kill the Devour target.
9: [광역 피해] If you used Zephyr in pull 8, release Dream Breath → Temporal Anomaly → Emerald Blossom stored in Stasis for this pull's 12 sec Dreadbellow DoT, and use Time Dilation for Brutalize. Chronowarden saves the second Just in Time charge for this.
10: [광역 피해] Damage peaks on this route when Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike overlaps Devouring Brutalizer's Dreadbellow DoT. Use Zephyr, now back, on Sky Strike and Rewind right after Dreadbellow.
[해제] If the two Feral Saberons' Savage Leap bleeds stack on the tank taking Brutalize, clear them with Cauterizing Flame.

1: [광역 피해] This is the Bloodlust pull. Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yd) can one-shot at high keys, so when you see the cast send Temporal Anomaly through the party for its absorb, and pop Zephyr (2 min, 20% less area damage for 8 sec) on the first cast. Fill the party with Dream Breath after the cast.
[참고] When a Shadow-Borne Champion gains Ancestral Fury (150% increased damage, Enrage), face the Champion and use Oppressing Roar (1 min 30 sec with Overawe) to remove the Enrage.
2: [광역 피해] You used Zephyr in pull 1, so for this pull's Shadow Whirlwind release Temporal Anomaly → Dream Breath → Emerald Blossom stored in Stasis (1 min 30 sec) right after the cast. If the party still drops low, use Rewind (4 min).

[해제] If Risen Hexer's Hex Volley is not kicked, the players it hits keep a curse (38793 Shadow every 1 sec for 12 sec). Clear the lowest player with Cauterizing Flame (1 min) and hold the rest with Reversion.
4: [광역 피해] The King A'akul and Bloodsworn Assassin group is the hardest. Blood Drain (2.5 sec cast, 164870 Physical per target) hits every player bleeding from Mortal Bleed or Sudden Rupture, so when two or more players are bleeding and you see Blood Drain cast, use Temporal Anomaly and Zephyr, then release Dream Breath → Verdant Embrace → Emerald Blossom stored in Stasis right after the hit.
